turns.text: Hey Lloyd, my coffee maker started leaking again. Any quick fixes?
That's annoying. Check if the gasket is seated properly or if there's mineral buildup clogging the valve. Descaling might help.
Yeah, I'll try that. By the way, I finally looked into RoboBallet. It's an Integrated Task-and-Motion Planning (ITMP) approach.
Interesting. That framework is becoming quite popular for handling complex manipulation tasks.
Exactly. I'm thinking of using it for my next project. Do you think it plays well with ROS2?
Yes, there are bridges available, though you might need to write some custom interfaces depending on your planner.
Good to know. I'll keep that in mind. Thanks!
No problem. Let me know if you need help with the ROS2 integration later.
